studies.title: Göbekli Tepe — c. 2010
studies.caption: About 2010. T-shaped pillars stand within a circular stone enclosure at Göbekli Tepe.
studies.prompt: Close archaeological view of excavated enclosure before modern canopy, two taller central T pillars, animal relief on one foreground pillar; no invented intact roofs, no Stonehenge lintels.
